review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm REF-01 ID alignment with Notion T-004A
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Identical content hash and locator span confirm unchanged source; automatic background change polling and claim auto-refresh remain Post-MVP.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm whether shifted-offset fuzzy re-anchoring is MVP or Post-MVP
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Inserted header changes content hash and shifts offsets; marks locator drift/unverifiable-now without claiming the historical fact is false or auto-updating the claim.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm user-facing status badge for HTTP 404/410/timeout
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: HTTP 404 means the source is currently unavailable/unverifiable; it MUST NOT be conflated with proving the past fact false.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm byte-limit truncation retry/error policy
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Truncated HTTP 206 response omits the baseline locator range -> currently unverifiable, not falsified and not verified.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm exact permission/retention policy failure codes
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: HTTP 403 / revoked OAuth scope prevents verification now without falsifying historical facts.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm full production SSRF/DNS-rebinding allowlist policy
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Metadata IPs, loopback, private CIDR, embedded credentials, and non-HTTPS schemes must be rejected prior to any outbound request.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm Option C zero-raw-text boundary for logs, caches, and traces
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Option C forbids persisting raw source text: clean persisted snapshot contains 0 canary tokens, while the negative leak fixture proves detector sensitivity.

review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm Post-MVP handoff boundary for automatic upstream change detection and Claim auto-refresh
expected_refetch_cases.rationale: Even when a manual refetch succeeds on a newer revision, MVP must not silently auto-detect changes or overwrite the user's Claim.
